_comment: Hardware-verified corrections to parameters whose published description is
wrong or misleading. Keyed by parameter id. Merged by
tools/build_parameters.py, which fails loudly if an id no longer exists so
a correction cannot silently rot when the extractor is re-run.

multi_part_program_number.notes: The Data List prints '1 - 128', but the wire value is 0-based. Verified: part 1 reported program 62 while the loaded kit was 'Synthetic Kit', which is 0-based program 62 of the drum Preset bank; a part set to the first voice reports 0, which '1 - 128' cannot express. No conversion is needed between this field and MIDI Program Change.
